```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 14
#| label: fig-barmapcoverage
#| fig-cap: "fig-barmapcoverage"
#| 

  graph_data <- targets::tar_read(data_vaccination_coverage_raw) %>%
                      filter(intervention_priority == "contact", intervention_setting == "home.social.sexual") %>%
                      group_by(vax_place) %>%
                      summarize(count = n()) %>%
                      ungroup() %>%
                      arrange(-count) %>%
                      mutate(community = factor(vax_place, unique(vax_place))) %>%
                      mutate(prop = count / sum(count)) %>%
                      mutate(cumprop = cumsum(prop)) %>%
                      mutate(group = "Group A") %>%
                      mutate(group = ifelse(cumprop > 0.33, "Group B", group)) %>%
                      mutate(group = ifelse(cumprop > 0.66, "Group C", group)) %>%
                      mutate(group = lead(group)) %>%
                      mutate(group = ifelse(is.na(group), "Group C", group)) 
  
  
 bar_graph <- graph_data %>%
                      filter(group %in% c("Group A", "Group B")) %>%
                      ggplot() +
                        geom_bar(
                                  aes(x = community, y = prop, fill = group), 
                                  stat = "identity", 
                                  color = "black", 
                                  size = 0.3, 
                                  width = 0.8
                                  ) +
                       theme_void() +
                       theme(
                         legend.position = "none",
                         plot.margin = margin(3, 0, 3, 0, "cm"),
                         axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
                         panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey"),
                         plot.title = element_text(size = 7)
                       ) +
                       scale_fill_manual(values = c("Group A" = dark_pink, "Group B" = dark_blue, "Group C" = "grey")) +
                       scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
                       scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
                       coord_flip() +
                       labs(
                         subtitle = "% Participants in\ncommunity district"
                       ) 
 
 
 
 
 map_graph <- mpxnyc::community_sf_obj %>%
                   left_join(graph_data) %>%
                   ggplot() +
                         geom_sf(aes(fill = group, alpha = group), color = "black") +
                         theme_void() +
                         theme(
                           legend.position = "none",
                           lot.margin = margin(2,1,2,1, "cm"),
                            plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
                            plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5
                                                         )
                         ) +
                         scale_fill_manual(
                                          values = c(
                                                        "Group A" = dark_pink, 
                                                        "Group B" = dark_blue, 
                                                        "Group C" = light_purple
                                                        ), 
                                           na.value = "grey"
                                           ) + 
                         scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Group A" = 1, "Group B" = 1, "Group C" = 0.5)) +
                         labs(
                                title     = captions_and_titles("barmapcoverage")$title,
                                subtitle  = captions_and_titles("barmapcoverage")$subtitle,
                                caption   = captions_and_titles("barmapcoverage")$caption
                                )
                   
  
 

 
 cowplot::ggdraw(map_graph) +
  cowplot::draw_plot(bar_graph, 0.1, 0.43, 0.25, 0.3)

  
```
